infrastructure.shell_injection_warning: Do NOT use here-doc (<<'EOF') pattern when embedding Python with subprocess that references shell vars - use a file written with cat and separate python3 call instead. Also avoid shell expansion patterns in --data-binary with $() nested in other commands.
